The g-invariant forest quotient respects arrow choices, rejects self-orbit cycles, and preserves acyclicity; the signed reduced Hopf trace becomes (-1)^k det(I-L_g). Identity uses the wheel Laplacian spectrum and exact cycle product; rotation and even-reflection matrices are singular; odd-reflection block determinant is (-1)^(q+1). The rational decomposition has the computed full character. A standalone exact verifier checks all 136 D_k cases for 5<=k<=12 and full signed chain trace for k=5,6,7. Finite cases are not used to prove unbounded quantifiers.

Jojić/Kozlov guarantee purity and shellability but do not compute the full automorphism action; Contreras–Tawfeek supply forest enumeration without these fixed-chain orientation traces. value.rationale: The classification determines an infinite series of genuine dihedral symmetry modules invisible to homology ranks: all even-rim modules are regular multiples, whereas odd-rim modules have a sign-twisted rim permutation summand. Their reflection traces distinguish parity in a natural combinatorial topology problem. This is substantive representation-level structure, not just recomputation of shellability, a renamed known Betti number or a one-off invariant.
